data: For the dataset 'Deception', what is the approximate 'Jensen-Shannon Score' value of the pink line representing 'BERT-SHAP x background' at the 'Number of Important features (k)' of 10?

The question asks for the approximate 'Jensen-Shannon Score' value of the pink line representing 'BERT-SHAP x background' at the 'Number of Important features (k)' of 10 on the dataset 'Deception'. 

From the caption, we know that the figure shows the distance of the part-of-speech tag distributions between important features and all words (background). The distance is generally smaller with post-hoc methods for all models, although some exceptions exist for LSTM with attention and BERT.

Looking at the graph labeled (c) Deception, we can see the pink line representing 'BERT-SHAP x background'. At the 'Number of Important features (k)' of 10, the pink line appears to be around 0.25. Therefore, the approximate 'Jensen-Shannon Score' value of the pink line at this point is 0.25.
